title: OML diagnosis record
description: One diagnosed learner response: the item, what was expected, what was given, and which OML misconceptions the response is evidence for. Schema version 0.1.

item.description: The task as shown to the learner, or a stable reference to it.

response.description: The learner's response. May be empty if the learner gave none.

diagnoses.description: Zero or more misconceptions the response is evidence for, most confident first. Empty means no OML record matched.

confidence.description: Engine's confidence that the learner holds this belief, given this response.

matched_pattern.description: Index into the record's `evidence_patterns` array that the response matched.

oml_version.description: Library release the diagnosis was made against (e.g. `0.1.0`).

engine_version.description: Identifier and version of the diagnosing system.

tenant_local_id.description: A local misconception id when the diagnosis is against a record not (yet) in OML.

insufficient_evidence.description: Present and true when the engine judged the response too thin to diagnose. `diagnoses` should then be empty.
